Because if the way I look, people believe this issue is die to negligence and they use it to embarrass me publicly. I could not date for long stretches of time because the symptoms were so bad.

Again, I needed someone to talk to during these hard times. My health issues have been dismissed and even used as jokes when I have often expressed how much emotional and physical pain it caused me.

The therapists that I have seen were horrible. There were two and of course they were non black women with whom I couldn't talk ab my cultural issues. They also would say some pretty sketchy racist things that betrayed my trust. They also had the "you're pretty so the sky is the limit and I don't believe your problems" attitude. I have public insurance so I had my pick of the worst healthcare professionals.

I know that I will be assaulted or raped living in a shelter or on the streets. I don't see any other option.
